episodes.synopsis: Something strange has been happening to John Watson. He goes to the detectives in Kabukicho for help, but they're even weirder!
episodes.title: Hello Detectives

episodes.synopsis: A woman is hired as an idol for her beautiful moles under her eyes. But when the day of her big show comes, the producer disappears! Is a crime involved?
episodes.title: Why Not Join the Staring-At-Eye-Moles Squad?

episodes.synopsis: A nephew is framed for the murder of his uncle, and it's up to Sherlock to clear his name.
episodes.title: The Dream of Fuyuto Kyokgoku, the Ace

episodes.synopsis: Now that he's broke, Watson has to use the public bath. But there's murder waiting for him there, too!
episodes.title: The Water's Usually Hot

episodes.synopsis: Mary's decided she wants to go to an expensive school, and Lucy decides to raise the money. But getting big money fast means taking big risks...
episodes.title: Offside is the Best Side

episodes.synopsis: Kobayashi runs into his old boss from his time in the Kaneko Gang. When one of the Kabukicho Irregulars steals a valuable sticker from the gangster, he'll have to risk it all to help them out.
episodes.title: Kobayashi the Man, Giving It His All

episodes.synopsis: Watson gets his first solo case as Sherlock sends him to investigate the home of the mysterious Irene Adler.
episodes.title: Wife Looks Into the Future

episodes.synopsis: Irene joins the team as they track down a medical chart in the possession of an infamous blackmailer, while Sherlock gets stuck with childcare duties.
episodes.title: Don't Take Off the Swimsuit

episodes.synopsis: Jack the Ripper is after Irene's life, and Sherlock and Watson must take extraordinary steps to protect her.
episodes.title: That Woman's Pad

episodes.synopsis: A badly depressed Watson struggles to come to terms with his new life, as Sherlock vows vengeance on Jack the Ripper.
episodes.title: Now Hiring Psychics

episodes.synopsis: The identity of Jack the Ripper is revealed when Sherlock finally makes his move.
episodes.title: Jack the Ripper

episodes.synopsis: The detectives try to cheer up after a hard week. Mrs. Hudson sends them after her missing cat to keep their minds occupied.
episodes.title: No More Nyan-Nyan

episodes.synopsis: While James has a difficult time in prison, Mycroft arrives at the row house and reflects on how Sherlock got his start in rakugo.
episodes.title: First Moonlit Night

episodes.synopsis: Fuyuto is in shock and not himself for several weeks after the events with Jack the Ripper. Sent to the hospital, he is met with a new case.
episodes.title: Take Back Your Melon Heart

episodes.synopsis: Watson and Mary do their best to stop the scammers that are planning a horrific upcoming terrorist attack.
episodes.title: Where Is He?

episodes.synopsis: Michel finally reunites with his long-lost daughter, but she is promptly arrested for murder soon after.
episodes.title: Michel and Dopey

episodes.synopsis: Ten months after the business with Michel's daughter, Sherlock cracks a mysterious code that leads to an even deeper mystery.
episodes.title: Looking Back on Saudade

episodes.synopsis: What starts off as an investigation into an animal killer, escalates into something far more sinister and dangerous.
episodes.title: Lots of Animals

episodes.synopsis: New information comes to light about all of the strange incidents, and the true cause of everything is finally revealed.
episodes.title: The Curtain Rises on the Grand Guignol

episodes.synopsis: As the villain makes his move, Watson finds himself in serious danger; Mary is caught in a compromising position.
episodes.title: Moriarty Savors

episodes.synopsis: With Watson's disappearance accomplished, the villain is prepared to execute the next phase of his master plan.
episodes.title: Not Breathing

episodes.synopsis: A Santa with a purple beard drops off some presents and a suspicious Sherlock chases after him before receivnig an invitation to a clandestine meeting.
episodes.title: The Thread Where We Talk About Yeast

episodes.synopsis: Watson desperately tries to find Sherlock before he reaches the point of no return. He even tries to hire the other detectives, but they refuse to help.
episodes.title: Everybody Be There at Eight

episodes.synopsis: Following the investigation into Moriarty, Sherlock performs his final rakugo entitled Moriarty the Living.
episodes.title: See You in Kabukicho!
